title: 第21章 统领级兽蛋反狩开启第22章 疯狂的夜狩单方面屠戮
slug: 御兽开局炼妖壶吞噬就变强
lines: 溪畔浅滩处，一头牛犊大小的盗蛋隐蜥正俯身饮水。
它土褐色的鳞甲与河岸卵石几乎融为一体，唯有那双琥珀色竖瞳不时转动，警惕地扫视着四周。
喝足溪水，盗蛋隐蜥不做停留，果断开溜。
鹿二发、孙雨棠只觉眼前一花，盗蛋隐蜥已是凭空消失。
然而在夜玄的破灭魔瞳视界中，一举一动都纤毫毕现，它正以诡异的步伐缓缓后退，鳞片随着微弱光线变幻色泽，每一步都精准避开枯枝落叶，不发出半点声响。
“走，跟上。”
夜玄眸绽黑色星光，保持安全距离跟随。
鹿二发与孙雨棠起身紧随其后，走的小心翼翼，唯恐踩到枯枝发出声响惊动蛋蜥…
盗蛋隐蜥生性狡黠，即使身处隐形状态，仍不时驻足，脑袋微抬，幽冷竖瞳四下扫视。
似要洞穿林中阴影，确保没有追踪者窥伺…
约莫半个时辰，盗蛋隐蜥终于停止脚步。
它用指爪拨开杂草，露出幽暗深邃树洞入口。
盗蛋隐蜥纵身钻入其中，片刻，一块树皮从内部小心翼翼伸出，严丝合缝地覆盖在洞口处。
整棵古树顿时恢复原貌，从未有过任何异样。
夜玄见状不再躲藏，带领二人上前当起土匪堵门！
一巴掌拍落，树皮破碎，重新显露出树洞。
“夜狩，探路。”
夜狩会意，一螳当先，飞身遁入黑黝树洞。
树洞中通外直，直通地底，夜狩进入没多久，洞内突然响起盗蛋隐蜥刺耳啼鸣！
数息之后，夜狩的身影自树洞中飞窜而出。
身后还背负着昏死过去的盗蛋隐蜥。
盗蛋隐蜥双眼泛白，粗壮后肢无意识颤动。
像是被吓晕过去。
夜玄拎着盗蛋隐蜥，笑眯眯的下达指令，“夜狩，把下面的蛋都给我掏出来。”
夜狩丢下盗蛋隐蜥，再次钻入下方树洞中。
掏…
丢…
掏…
丢…
一枚枚五颜六色兽蛋飞出，又被夜玄三人接住。
短短三分钟时间，竟足足得到二十余颗兽蛋。
一笔不菲的白嫖收获。
夜玄笑的很开心，苏醒的盗蛋隐蜥则欲哭无泪，眼巴巴望着可恶的人类当众盗窃自己战利品，浑然忘记自己也是小偷。
“怎么，你这小偷蛋贼不服气？”
content_en:
;;
"Roar..."
In the shallows by the stream, a calf-sized egg-stealing lizard was leaning over to drink water.
Its earthy brown scales almost blended into the pebbles on the riverbank. Only its pair of amber vertical pupils turned from time to time, scanning the surroundings vigilantly.
After drinking enough stream water, the egg-stealing lizard will not stop and run away decisively.
Lu Erfa and Sun Yutang only felt a blur in front of their eyes, and the egg-stealing hidden lizard had disappeared out of thin air.
However, in the vision of Ye Xuan's Demonic Eye of Destruction, every move was clearly visible. It was slowly retreating at a strange pace, its scales changing color with the faint light, and every step accurately avoided dead branches and leaves without making the slightest sound.
"Go, follow."
Ye Xuan's eyes sparkled with black stars, and he followed him at a safe distance.
Lu Erfa and Sun Yutang stood up and followed closely, walking cautiously, lest they step on dead branches and make a sound that would alert the egg lizard...
"Hiss..."
The egg-stealing hidden lizard is cunning by nature. Even if it is invisible, it will still stop from time to time, raise its head slightly, and glance around with its cold vertical pupils.
As if to penetrate the shadows of the forest to ensure that no pursuers are watching...
After about half an hour, the egg-stealing hidden lizard finally stopped.
It pushed aside the weeds with its claws, revealing the dark and deep entrance to the tree hole.
The Egg-stealing Cryptolizard jumped into it, and after a moment, a piece of bark carefully stretched out from the inside, covering the entrance of the hole tightly.
The entire ancient tree immediately returned to its original appearance, never looking any different.
Seeing this, Ye Xuan stopped hiding and led the two of them forward to block the door like bandits!
"Crack!"
With a slap, the bark of the tree shattered, revealing the tree hole again.
"Night hunting, exploring the road."
"Hiss!"
The night hunter realized what he was doing, and a mantis took the lead and flew into the hole of a dark tree.
The tree hole leads directly to the outside and to the ground. Not long after the night hunter entered, the shrill cry of the egg-stealing lizard suddenly sounded in the hole!
After a few breaths, Ye Shou's figure flew out of the tree hole.
Behind him was also carrying the unconscious Egg-stealing Hidden Lizard.
The egg-stealing cryptolizard's eyes turned white, and its thick hind limbs trembled unconsciously.
As if fainted from fright.
Ye Xuan carried the egg-stealing lizard and gave the order with a smile, "Ye Shou, take out all the eggs underneath."
"Hiss!"
Ye Shou dropped the egg-stealing lizard and crawled into the tree hole below again.
Dig…
Lost…
Dig…
Lost…
Colorful eggs flew out one after another and were caught by Ye Xuan and the others.
In just three minutes, more than twenty eggs were obtained.
A huge sum of money from whoring.
Ye Xuan smiled happily, while the awakened egg-thief Hidden Lizard was on the verge of crying, looking eagerly at the hateful humans stealing his loot in public, completely forgetting that he was also a thief.
"Why, you little egg thief are not convinced?"
